summary: A dispatch-pinned Review report names one CD-0242 D5 disposition and up to 64 ranked findings with closed severity and confidence. Oracle-bound findings retain their classifications and canonical identities. Resolution claims carry qualifying native references for executable requirements and exact judged-case identities for Review-judged requirements. Judged proposals close only on Main's acceptance of the exact current Review, never at ingest or rejection. The report grants no workflow verdict or acceptance authority.
title: A review report carries a typed verdict and ranked findings
